songs.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
You step outside and button your coat
The air is clean against your face
Yesterday the street looked ordinary
Today it wears a painted grace
Leaves gather red along the curbside
A yellow branch bends near the gate
The mailbox wears a copper crown
And frost is silver on the slate

[Pre-Chorus]
You stand there longer than you meant to
Letting all the hurry wait
A breath turns white, then vanishes

[Chorus]
One cold breath, one grateful minute
See the Colors
The whole block turns and offers
What you did not know you needed
And the pavement shines like ribbon

[Verse 2]
A cup waits on the kitchen counter
The kettle cools behind the door
But you keep watching from the walkway
As if the map has changed once more
A neighbor waves across the hedges
You lift your hand and simply smile
The cold does not ask for speeches
Only that you stay awhile
The whole street seems newly written
In a careful, colored hand

[Chorus]
One cold breath, one grateful minute
The whole block turns and offers
See the Colors
What you did not know you needed

[Key-Lift Final Chorus]
See the Colors
One cold breath, one grateful minute
The whole block turns and offers
What you did not know you needed
Right here where you stand
See the Colors
